input: M6_TU_steps_v1 threshold10 R_plausible, 10 systems with >=100 selected 3h events
relative_signal: cell step R minus median of other valid cells at same physical pack event
threshold: 99th percentile of positive relative signal from other systems, lower floor 0.3mOhm; no held system future rows
persistence: causal median of last 5 cell events exceeds threshold after 5 observations
injection_targets: each of eight cells in each held system if >=80 valid events
assessed: new alert detection delay and alert count on unmodified data; original alerts cannot be labeled true/false without fault ground truth
paper_relation: BattGP author code uses probabilistic fault rule on inferred R0 with 0.55mOhm band and 2mOhm upper threshold; this is a different step-response and deterministic approximate detector
